title: Testing a pipeline: unit, integration, and a fixture that is real data

videos.script: Data tests ask whether tonight's data is right. They cannot ask whether the code is. {{two}} Ana makes her validator callable, one record at a time. {{refactor}} Seven unit tests. One fails. A price in reais, as a number, went straight through. {{float}} A unit test for a SQL model: half past eleven at night is still the same day. {{dbt}} She cuts one real day out of the shop, and keeps it beside the tests. Names and e-mails replaced. {{fixture}} The integration test hangs. Its own open transaction holds a lock that dbt is waiting for. {{hang}} Autocommit, and all ten pass.
